fusions.name: Bast Winding
fusions.desc: Throws a length of bark fibre that winds round the first enemy it meets and deals 11 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Kapok Burst
fusions.desc: Splits a seed pod and looses its floss 4 tiles ahead of you; it deals 7 damage to everything caught in it and leaves it [Blunted] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Draped Canopy
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies in hanging moss for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. Attacking ends it.

fusions.name: Fibre Bandage
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, healing you receive is 30% stronger for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
